column1: Hearing impairment or other auditory function deficit in young children can have a major impact on their development of speech and communication, resulting in a detrimental effect on their ability to learn at school.
column2: 幼儿的听力障碍或其他听觉功能缺陷会严重影响他们的语言发展和沟通能力，从而对其在学校的学习能力产生负面影响。

column1: This is likely to have major consequences for the individual and the population as a whole.
column2: 这很可能会对个人以及整个群体产生重大影响。

column1: The New Zealand Ministry of Health has found from research carried out over two decades that 6-10% of children in that country are affected by hearing loss.
column2: 新西兰卫生部通过长达二十年的研究发现，该国有6%到10%的儿童患有听力损失问题。

column1: A preliminary study in New Zealand has shown that classroom noise presents a major concern for teachers and pupils.
column2: 一项在新西兰进行的初步研究表明，课堂噪音是教师和学生的主要关切。

column1: Modern teaching practices, the organisation of desks in the classroom, poor classroom acoustics, and mechanical means of ventilation such as air-conditioning units all contribute to the number of children unable to comprehend the teacher’s voice.
column2: 现代教学方式、课桌的摆放、不良的教室声学环境，以及空调等机械通风设备，都会使更多儿童听不懂老师说的话。
column5: classroom acoustics|n. 教室的声学环境
column6: mechanical means of ventilation|机械通风方式

column1: Education researchers Nelson and Soli have also suggested that recent trends in learning often involve collaborative interaction of multiple minds and tools as much as individual possession of information.
column2: 教育研究者纳尔逊和索利还提出，近年的学习往往既涉及多人和多种工具之间的协作互动，也同样涉及个人对信息的掌握。
column8: multiple minds and tools|多人的思考与多种工具
column10: individual possession of information|个人对信息的掌握

column1: This all amounts to heightened activity and noise levels, which have the potential to be particularly serious for children experiencing auditory function deficit.
column2: 这些都意味着课堂活动增多，噪声水平升高。对听觉功能有障碍的儿童来说，这种情况可能尤其严重。
column10: auditory function deficit|n. 听觉功能障碍

column1: Noise in classrooms can only exacerbate their difficulty in comprehending and processing verbal communication with other children and instructions from the teacher.
column2: 教室里的噪声只会让这些儿童更难理解和处理两类口头信息：他们与其他儿童交流时听到的话，以及老师的指令。

column1: Children with auditory function deficit are potentially failing to learn to their maximum potential because of noise levels generated in classrooms.
column2: 那些存在听觉功能缺陷的儿童，由于教室内的噪音水平过高，可能无法充分发挥他们的学习潜力。

column1: The effects of noise on the ability of children to learn effectively in typical classroom environments are now the subject of increasing concern.
column2: 噪音对儿童在典型教室环境中的有效学习能力的影响，如今已成为一个备受关注的课题。

column1: The International Institute of Noise Control Engineering (I-INCE), on the advice of the World Health Organization, has established an international working party, which includes New Zealand, to evaluate noise and reverberation control for school rooms.
column2: 国际噪声控制工程学会（I-INCE）根据世界卫生组织的建议，成立了一个有新西兰参与的国际工作组，负责评估学校教室的噪声与混响控制。
column3: on the advice of|根据……的建议
column4: World Health Organization|n. 世界卫生组织
column6: international working party|n. 国际工作组

column1: While the detrimental effects of noise in classroom situations are not limited to children experiencing disability, those with a disability that affects their processing of speech and verbal communication could be extremely vulnerable.
column2: 课堂噪声的不良影响并不限于有障碍的儿童，不过，如果某种障碍影响到儿童处理言语和口头交流信息的能力，他们就可能尤其容易受到噪声的伤害。
column7: processing of speech|对言语信息的处理

column1: The auditory function deficits in question include hearing impairment, autistic spectrum disorders (ASD) and attention deficit disorders (ADD/ADHD).
column2: 所涉及的听觉功能缺陷包括听力障碍、自闭症谱系障碍和注意力缺陷障碍。

column1: Autism is considered a neurological and genetic life-long disorder that causes discrepancies in the way information is processed.
column2: 自闭症被认为是一种神经性和遗传性的终身性疾病，会导致信息处理的机制出现异常。

column1: This disorder is characterised by interlinking problems with social imagination, social communication and social interaction.
column2: 这种病症的特点在于，患者在社交想象力、社交沟通以及社交互动方面都存在相互关联的问题。

column1: According to Janzen, this affects the ability to understand and relate in typical ways to people, understand events and objects in the environment, and understand or respond to sensory stimuli.
column2: 根据詹岑的观点，这会影响儿童理解并以典型方式与他人互动、理解环境中的事件和物体，以及对感官刺激的理解或反应能力。
column7: relate|v. 以典型方式与他人互动
column12: respond|v. 对感官刺激的理解或反应

column1: Autism does not allow learning or thinking in the same ways as in children who are developing normally.
column2: 自闭症患者无法像正常发育的儿童那样进行学习和思考。

column1: Autistic spectrum disorders often result in major difficulties in comprehending verbal information and speech processing.
column2: 自闭症谱系障碍通常会导致患者在理解口头信息和处理言语方面存在严重困难。

column1: Those experiencing these disorders often find sounds such as crowd noise and the noise generated by machinery painful and distressing.
column2: 那些经历这些障碍的儿童常常觉得人群噪音和机器产生的噪音痛苦且令人烦恼。

column1: This is difficult to scientifically quantify as such extra-sensory stimuli vary greatly from one autistic individual to another.
column2: 这种影响很难用科学方法进行量化分析，因为不同自闭症患者所经历的超感官刺激差异很大。

column1: But a child who finds any type of noise in their classroom or learning space intrusive is likely to be adversely affected in their ability to process information.
column2: 但如果一个孩子在教室或学习环境中听到任何类型的噪音，那么他们的信息处理能力就会受到负面影响。

column1: The attention deficit disorders are indicative of neurological and genetic disorders and are characterised by difficulties with sustaining attention, effort and persistence, organisation skills and disinhibition.
column2: 注意缺陷类障碍是神经和遗传方面异常的表现。其特征包括难以持续集中注意、保持努力并坚持做事，组织能力较弱，也难以抑制冲动。
column3: attention deficit disorders|n. 注意缺陷类障碍
column6: genetic disorders|n. 遗传方面的障碍

column1: Children experiencing these disorders find it difficult to screen out unimportant information, and focus on everything in the environment rather than attending to a single activity.
column2: 患有这些障碍的儿童难以过滤无关信息，往往将注意力分散到环境中的所有事物，而无法专注于单一活动。

column1: Background noise in the classroom becomes a major distraction, which can affect their ability to concentrate.
column2: 课堂上的背景噪音会成为主要的干扰因素，影响学生集中注意力的能力。

column1: Children experiencing an auditory function deficit can often find speech and communication very difficult to isolate and process when set against high levels of background noise.
column2: 在背景噪声很强时，听觉功能有障碍的儿童往往很难单独辨别出言语和交流信息并加以处理。
column3: auditory function deficit|n. 听觉功能障碍
column10: high levels of background noise|强烈的背景噪声

column1: These levels come from outside activities that penetrate the classroom structure, from teaching activities, and other noise generated inside, which can be exacerbated by room reverberation.
column2: 这些噪声来自穿过教室围护结构传入的室外活动声，也来自教学活动和室内产生的其他声音。室内的混响还会使噪声加剧。
column6: classroom structure|n. 教室的建筑结构

column1: Strategies are needed to obtain the optimum classroom construction and perhaps a change in classroom culture and methods of teaching.
column2: 需要采取措施，把教室建得尽可能适合教学。课堂文化和教学方法或许也需要改变。
column6: classroom construction|n. 教室的建造方式
column9: methods of teaching|n. 教学方法

column1: In particular, the effects of noisy classrooms and activities on those experiencing disabilities in the form of auditory function deficit need thorough investigation.
column2: 特别是，嘈杂的教室环境以及各种活动对那些存在听觉功能障碍的人士的影响，需要得到深入的研究。

column1: It is probable that many undiagnosed children exist in the education system with ‘invisible’ disabilities.
column2: 在教育系统中，很可能存在着许多未被诊断出的、患有‘隐形’残疾的儿童。

column1: Their needs are less likely to be met than those of children with known disabilities.
column2: 与那些有明确残疾的儿童相比，这些儿童的需求更难以得到满足。

column1: The New Zealand Government has developed a New Zealand Disability Strategy and has embarked on a wide-ranging consultation process.
column2: 新西兰政府已制定《新西兰残疾人战略》，并启动了广泛的咨询过程。

column1: The strategy recognises that people experiencing disability face significant barriers in achieving a full quality of life in areas such as attitude, education, employment and access to services.
column2: 这一战略承认，有障碍的人若要充分享有优质生活，面临着重重阻碍，涉及社会态度、教育、就业和获取服务等方面。
column7: quality of life|n. 生活质量
column11: access to services|获得服务的机会

column1: Objective 3 of the New Zealand Disability Strategy is to ‘Provide the Best Education for Disabled People’ by improving education so that all children, youth learners and adult learners will have equal opportunities to learn and develop within their already existing local school.
column2: 《新西兰残障战略》的第三项目标是“为残障人士提供最好的教育”。为此要改善教育，使所有儿童、青年和成人学习者都能在当地现有学校平等地获得学习和发展的机会。

column1: For a successful education, the learning environment is vitally significant, so any effort to improve this is likely to be of great benefit to all children, but especially to those with auditory function disabilities.
column2: 学习环境对教育能否成功至关重要。因此，为改善环境所作的任何努力都很可能让所有儿童大为受益，听觉功能有障碍的儿童尤其如此。
column10: auditory function disabilities|n. 听觉功能障碍

column1: A number of countries are already in the process of formulating their own standards for the control and reduction of classroom noise.
column2: 许多国家已经在制定自己的标准，以控制和减少教室内的噪音水平。

column1: New Zealand will probably follow their example.
column2: 新西兰可能会效仿他们的做法。

column1: The literature to date on noise in school rooms appears to focus on the effects on schoolchildren in general, their teachers and the hearing impaired.
column2: 迄今为止关于学校教室噪音的文献似乎聚焦于对普通学生、教师及听力受损者的影响。

column1: Only limited attention appears to have been given to those students experiencing the other disabilities involving auditory function deficit.
column2: 至于那些有其他障碍、且障碍涉及听觉功能的学生，他们受到的关注似乎相当有限。
column4: appears to have been given|似乎已受到
column5: other disabilities|n. 其他类型的障碍
column7: auditory function deficit|n. 听觉功能障碍

column1: It is imperative that the needs of these children are taken into account in the setting of appropriate international standards to be promulgated in future.
column2: 在制定日后将颁布的相关国际标准时，务必考虑这些儿童的需要。
